title: nassella holwayi
intro: Nassella holwayi, commonly known as Holway's needle grass, is a type of grass native to North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Nassella holwayi include antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it a potential treatment for various skin and wound infections. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids and flavonoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
